messages:
Jordan Hayes: heads-up: we're getting a burst of 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference us-west-1 starting ~07:03 PDT. Customers report API requests hanging ~25-30s then 5xx. Alerts: gateway 5xx rate + p99 token latency. Opening this thread to triage.

MonitorBot: Alert triggered: hosted-inference.us-west-1.gateway.5xx_rate > 4% (07:05) https://monitoring.internal/alerts/inf-9021

Oncall SRE: I have the pager. Early logs show repeated `upstream timeout` and `connection reset by peer` when gateway talks to runtime pools. There are also intermittent auth failures `introspect 502`. Pulling traces now.

Meera Singh: I'm seeing a pattern of retries from our public SDKs — many clients are retrying on timeout and some SDKs default to exponential backoff with 3 retries, which is amplifying load. Also noticed an increase in `session affinity` evictions in the LB logs.

Tom Alvarez: runtime pool metrics: runtime-a (v2) showing elevated memory pressure and GC spikes, runtime-b (v1) healthy but limited capacity. There was a push earlier this morning to increase concurrency per-worker for v2 (PR #6002) — could be exposing memory fragmentation under load.

Ivy Park: Support reports high-priority tickets from two customers (PixelFrame & NuLearner) with timeouts during batch inference runs. PixelFrame attached request IDs and timestamps. They want mitigation ASAP and credits if SLA breached.

Jordan Hayes: immediate mitigations we should consider: 1) reduce gateway max-inflight to shed load 2) temporarily reduce SDK retry attempts via config/feature flag 3) divert heavy customers to runtime-b 4) rollback concurrency PR on runtime-v2 5) pause billing capture for 5xx window. Assignable?

Oncall SRE: I'll flip gateway to prefer fast-fail. Command to run: ```bash
kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gateway MAX_INFLIGHT=400 && kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gateway UPSTREAM_RETRIES=0 && kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deployment/gateway
```
Executing now.

DeployBot: gateway rollout started by OncallSRE (deploy-7721) https://ci.internal/redwood/deploys/7721

Meera Singh: I'll open an emergency feature flag to lower SDK retries for hosted customers and push a config to the public SDK flags service to set retries=1 for 20m. This requires a fast push but avoids a client-side update.

Support Lead: I'll notify PixelFrame & NuLearner immediately and offer interim routing to runtime-b if they'd like. Also queuing a credit check for accounts that experienced >=3 failed requests in the window.

Tom Alvarez: starting a rollback of the concurrency change on runtime-v2 canary now. Cmd: ```bash
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deployment/runtime-v2 --to-revision=18 && kubectl -n runtime rollout status deployment/runtime-v2 -w
```
Rolling back canary.

Oncall SRE: gateway config applied. Early telemetry: queue depth dropped from ~4200 -> ~900 in ~2m; 5xx rate decreasing slightly. Will watch for client-impact.

Tom Alvarez: canary rollback shows lower RSS and fewer GC spikes on those pods. Promoting rollback across replicas after sanity.

Meera Singh: SDK retries flag pushed. Observed client-side retry attempts drop almost immediately (we have telemetry from SDK telemetry pipeline). That appears to stop amplification of repeated requests.

BillingSvc: flagged potential duplicate billing events for requests with status 5xx between 07:02 and 07:20. Recommend pausing finalization for those invoices until incident clears.

Ivy Park: PixelFrame confirms routing to runtime-b worked for a subset of jobs and they saw fewer timeouts. NuLearner requested we keep them on the fallback for 2 hours while we stabilize.

Oncall SRE: rolling runtime-v2 rollback completed cluster-wide. GC/oom events dropped. 5xx rate now ~0.9% and p99 token latency back toward baseline. Monitoring shows steady decline.

Jordan Hayes: outstanding action items for immediate follow-up: - Owner: Tom  run memory/heap profiling on runtime-v2 and revert or tune concurrency settings; include load tests with long-sequence workloads - Owner: Meera  add a server-side knob to temporarily limit SDK retries per-customer and instrument SDK flag TTLs - Owner: BillingSvc  implement billing-hold for requests with non-200 status during incident windows and surface candidate duplicates to finance - Owner: Support Lead  finalize comms and credits for PixelFrame & NuLearner - Owner: Oncall SRE  add a runbook entry: when auth-introspect errors spike, prefer rollback and reduce MAX_INFLIGHT first

Tom Alvarez: filing follow-ups: GH-7010 (runtime-v2-concurrency-profiling), GH-7011 (long-seq load tests in CI), GH-7012 (safety limit on worker concurrency).

Meera Singh: I'll also add an alert to detect SDK-side retry amplification: when gateway retry-to-success ratio > 0.5 for 5m trigger.

BillingSvc: paused invoice finalization for the incident window; finance notified to manually reconcile duplicates flagged (ref: FIN-1198).

Support Lead: sent customer notes and credit offers. PixelFrame acknowledged; NuLearner requested an ETA for full mitigation. I put both in a priority follow-up list.

Oncall SRE: incident stabilized; monitor shows 5xx back to baseline at 07:18 PDT. Will draft a postmortem and share.

Jordan Hayes: good job team. We'll do a 30m post-incident review at 09:00 PDT and produce an RCA. Please add timeline entries and attach logs/traces to the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/pm/incident-2450007777-draft

Support Lead: ticket refs added: S-9802, S-9803, S-9804. Closing loop here; will update the doc after the review.

(emoji) :handshake:
